name: Dorei Iinchou ~Haramase Choukyou~
original_name: 奴隷委員長～孕ませ調教～
source:
Main character is an ordinary student boy unpopular with the girls. One day he overhears girls badmouthing him. He vows to have revenge over ringleader - class chairman - and to make her his slave.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vn-of-month-september-2006-pp.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一名普通男学生，在女生中毫无人气。某天，他偶然听见几名女生在背后说自己的坏话。他发誓要报复带头的班长，将她变成自己的奴隶。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vn-of-month-september-2006-pp.html]vndbreview[/url]]
